sprint_note: Adds scheduled status support: migration 009, schema.sql update, tasks.py changes, ShellEntry.tsx Scheduled tab, shellConfig.ts nav update.

files.role: Package metadata and dependency declarations — fastapi, uvicorn, psycopg2-binary, pydantic, httpx
Container image definition — python:3.12-slim, copies platform_packages into /platform_packages and sets PYTHONPATH, installs pyproject.toml deps, starts uvicorn backend.main:app on port 8000
Docker Compose service definition for tasktracker: port 127.0.0.1:8010:8000, ATLAS_PG_* env vars, LABEL_ENGINE_URL and PREFERENCE_STORE_URL service references, logs volume, atlas-net network

Canonical DDL for the tasktracker schema — updated to include scheduled_at timestamptz column and expanded status check constraint (open/in_progress/scheduled/pending/done); idempotent via ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS and DROP/ADD CONSTRAINT
Migration: drop and re-add tasks_status_check to include 'scheduled'; add scheduled_at timestamptz column; create partial index ix_tasks_scheduled_at on status='scheduled' rows
Local development launcher — loads 01_System/secrets.env, sets PYTHONPATH to platform packages (mirrors Docker), overrides ATLAS_PG_HOST to 127.0.0.1, starts uvicorn on port 8010

private_objects.name: load_env
private_objects.purpose: Parse a key=value env file and populate os.environ using setdefault semantics (does not overwrite existing vars).

files.role: Connection pool management and schema initialization — builds DSN from ATLAS_PG_* env vars or DATABASE_URL override, manages a psycopg2 SimpleConnectionPool with RealDictCursor, executes schema.sql on startup

public_objects.name: DATABASE_URL
public_objects.purpose: Module-level DSN string computed at import time from _build_url().

public_objects.name: init_pool
public_objects.purpose: Initialize the psycopg2 SimpleConnectionPool (minconn=1, maxconn=5, RealDictCursor) using the module-level DATABASE_URL.

public_objects.name: init_schema
public_objects.purpose: Execute schema.sql (located one directory above backend/) against the database — idempotent via IF NOT EXISTS.

public_objects.name: get_db
public_objects.purpose: Context manager that yields a pooled connection, rolls back on exception, and returns the connection to the pool on exit.

private_objects.name: _build_url
private_objects.purpose: Construct Postgres DSN from DATABASE_URL environment override or ATLAS_PG_* variables (user, password, host, port, db).

private_objects.name: _pool
private_objects.purpose: Module-level SimpleConnectionPool instance, None until init_pool() is called.

files.role: FastAPI application entrypoint — constructs app, installs CORS middleware (all localhost ports), platform exception handlers and request timing, mounts tasks router under /api, initializes pool and schema on startup

public_objects.name: app
public_objects.purpose: FastAPI application instance (title='TaskTracker', version='0.1.0'). Mounts tasks router at /api prefix with CORS, error handling, and request timing middleware.

private_objects.name: on_startup
private_objects.purpose: FastAPI startup event handler — calls init_pool() then init_schema(); logs errors without raising so uvicorn continues running if the database is temporarily unavailable.

files.role: All task HTTP endpoints plus label and preference proxy endpoints — CRUD for tasks (list, create, patch, delete), label search/used/attach/detach/set, and preference read/write for the label filter; all read endpoints return Dataset, mutations return Dataset or 204

public_objects.name: router
public_objects.purpose: APIRouter instance with prefix=/tasks and tag='tasks', mounted by main.py under /api.

public_objects.name: TASK_SCHEMA
public_objects.purpose: [CHANGED] Stable list of ColumnSchema objects for the tasks Dataset — title, status, priority, due_date, effort_hours, scheduled_at, created_at, description. scheduled_at: key='scheduled_at', label='Scheduled At', type='string', sortable=True, filterable=False.

public_objects.name: VALID_STATUS
public_objects.purpose: [CHANGED] Allowed task status values: open, in_progress, scheduled, pending, done.

public_objects.name: VALID_PRIORITY
public_objects.purpose: Allowed task priority values: low, medium, high.

public_objects.name: VALID_VIEW
public_objects.purpose: [CHANGED] Allowed view parameter values: active, pending_board, scheduled.

public_objects.name: TaskCreate
public_objects.purpose: [CHANGED] Request body for POST /api/tasks. Now includes optional scheduled_at (required when status=scheduled).

public_objects.name: TaskUpdate
public_objects.purpose: [CHANGED] Request body for PATCH /api/tasks/{task_id}. Now includes optional scheduled_at. Uses model_fields_set to distinguish field omission from explicit null — critical for scheduled_at and effort_hours clear semantics.

public_objects.name: LabelAttachBody
public_objects.purpose: Request body for POST /api/tasks/{task_id}/labels.

public_objects.name: LabelFilterPutBody
public_objects.purpose: Request body for PUT /api/tasks/preferences/label_filter.

public_objects.name: LabelSetBody
public_objects.purpose: Request body for PUT /api/tasks/{task_id}/labels — atomically replaces all labels by name.

private_objects.name: LABEL_ENGINE_URL
private_objects.purpose: Base URL for LabelEngine service — from LABEL_ENGINE_URL env var, default http://localhost:8050.

private_objects.name: PREFERENCE_STORE_URL
private_objects.purpose: Base URL for PreferenceStore service — from PREFERENCE_STORE_URL env var, default http://localhost:8060.

private_objects.name: _label_client
private_objects.purpose: Return a configured httpx.Client targeting LABEL_ENGINE_URL with a 5s timeout.

private_objects.name: _preference_client
private_objects.purpose: Return a configured httpx.Client targeting PREFERENCE_STORE_URL with a 5s timeout.

private_objects.name: row_to_dict
private_objects.purpose: [CHANGED] Convert a psycopg2 RealDictRow to a plain dict — coerces uuid id to str, date and timestamptz fields (including scheduled_at) to ISO datetime strings or null.

private_objects.name: fetch_labels_for_tasks
private_objects.purpose: Batch-fetch labels for a list of task IDs via LabelEngine POST /api/objects/labels/batch; returns {task_id: [{id, name, attached_at}]} or empty dict on failure.

private_objects.name: dataset_response
private_objects.purpose: Serialize a Dataset to JSONResponse using model_dump(by_alias=True, mode='json').

private_objects.name: single_row_dataset
private_objects.purpose: Wrap a single task row dict in a Dataset with total=1 and row_actions=['edit', 'delete'].

private_objects.name: _run_auto_promotion
private_objects.purpose: [NEW] Execute the auto-promotion UPDATE: set status='in_progress', updated_at=now() WHERE status='scheduled' AND scheduled_at IS NOT NULL AND scheduled_at::date <= CURRENT_DATE. Runs within the same DB connection before the view SELECT. Takes a DB connection as argument.

private_objects.name: list_tasks
private_objects.purpose: [CHANGED] GET /api/tasks — paginated task list; supports status filter and view=active (auto-promote then SELECT NOT IN done/pending/scheduled plus done-today), view=pending_board (auto-promote then SELECT open/pending), view=scheduled (SELECT scheduled ORDER BY scheduled_at ASC); embeds labels via batch fetch from LabelEngine.

private_objects.name: create_task
private_objects.purpose: [CHANGED] POST /api/tasks — validates and inserts a new task including optional scheduled_at; enforces scheduled_at required when status=scheduled; returns single-row Dataset.

private_objects.name: update_task
private_objects.purpose: [CHANGED] PATCH /api/tasks/{task_id} — partial update; only fields present in model_fields_set are applied; supports scheduled_at field; enforces scheduled_at presence when status=scheduled (via deferred decision logic); returns single-row Dataset or 404 ApiError.

private_objects.name: delete_task
private_objects.purpose: DELETE /api/tasks/{task_id} — removes the task; returns empty Dataset (200) or 404 ApiError.

private_objects.name: search_labels
private_objects.purpose: GET /api/tasks/labels/search?q= — proxies LabelEngine GET /api/labels; returns Dataset of matching label records.

private_objects.name: list_used_labels
private_objects.purpose: GET /api/tasks/labels/used — proxies LabelEngine GET /api/labels/used?object_type=task; degrades gracefully to empty Dataset on LabelEngine failure.

private_objects.name: get_label_filter_preference
private_objects.purpose: GET /api/tasks/preferences/label_filter — proxies PreferenceStore GET for scope=tasktracker.task-list key=label_filter; passes through Dataset or 404 ApiError.

private_objects.name: put_label_filter_preference
private_objects.purpose: PUT /api/tasks/preferences/label_filter — proxies PreferenceStore PUT to persist label_ids as JSON array under scope=tasktracker.task-list key=label_filter.

private_objects.name: get_task_labels
private_objects.purpose: GET /api/tasks/{task_id}/labels — proxies LabelEngine; returns Dataset of labels attached to the task.

private_objects.name: attach_task_label
private_objects.purpose: POST /api/tasks/{task_id}/labels — proxies LabelEngine to attach a label by name to the task.

private_objects.name: detach_task_label
private_objects.purpose: DELETE /api/tasks/{task_id}/labels/{label_id} — proxies LabelEngine; returns 204 on success.

private_objects.name: set_task_labels
private_objects.purpose: PUT /api/tasks/{task_id}/labels — atomically replaces all labels: fetches current labels, detaches each, then attaches each name in the new list.

files.role: Migration 009: expand status CHECK constraint to include 'scheduled'; add scheduled_at timestamptz column; create partial index on scheduled tasks
[CHANGED] Atlas Shell registration — adds Scheduled tab to mobilePrimaryNav and desktopNav (order 2, /tasks/scheduled); Pending shifts to order 3, Done to order 4

[CHANGED] Main React entry point — adds Scheduled tab (ViewTab='scheduled'), viewFetchUrl branch for view=scheduled, route /tasks/scheduled, scheduled_at field in TaskRow, scheduled status options in create/edit forms, datetime-local input for scheduled_at, ScheduledRow rendering

public_objects.name: ShellEntry
public_objects.purpose: [CHANGED] Default export. Root component mounted by the Atlas Shell — wraps TasksPage in React Router Routes at /tasks, /tasks/scheduled, /tasks/pending, /tasks/done.

public_objects.name: TasksPage
public_objects.purpose: Primary view controller — manages active/scheduled/pending/done tab state, task list fetching, label filter state, create/edit panel visibility, and coordinates all child components.

public_objects.name: LabelFilterBar
public_objects.purpose: Horizontal chip bar for filtering the task list by label — loads used labels from /tasks/labels/used, reads persisted selection from /tasks/preferences/label_filter, persists changes on toggle.

public_objects.name: TaskGroupedList
public_objects.purpose: Renders tasks grouped by status (Open / Pending sections) with per-group effort summaries — used for the Pending board view.

public_objects.name: TaskCreatePanel
public_objects.purpose: [CHANGED] Slide-in panel for creating a new task — includes title, description, priority, due date, effort, label, and scheduled status fields. When status=scheduled, shows required datetime-local input for scheduled_at. After successful creation with status=scheduled, navigates to Scheduled tab.

public_objects.name: TaskDetailEdit
public_objects.purpose: [CHANGED] Inline edit panel for an existing task — all editable fields plus label management. When status=scheduled (or user selects scheduled), shows datetime-local input for scheduled_at. When status changes away from scheduled, clears scheduled_at (sends null in PATCH).

public_objects.name: TaskCard
public_objects.purpose: Single task row card — displays title, status, priority chip, due date, effort, and label chips; exposes edit, delete, and link actions via ThreeDotsMenu.

public_objects.name: LabelPopover
public_objects.purpose: Popover for attaching labels to a task — searches labels by prefix via /tasks/labels/search and attaches on selection.

public_objects.name: LabelSection
public_objects.purpose: Displays and manages the label chips on a task card or edit panel — renders attached labels and provides detach affordance.

public_objects.name: ThreeDotsMenu
public_objects.purpose: Overflow menu for a task card providing edit, delete, and link actions.

public_objects.name: LinkModal
public_objects.purpose: Modal for creating typed task-to-task links (SubTask, Related To) — searches all tasks by title and submits the relationship.

private_objects.name: formatEffort
private_objects.purpose: Format an effort_hours number as a human-readable string (e.g. '2 h', '1.5 h', '0 h').

private_objects.name: formatScheduledAt
private_objects.purpose: [NEW] Format a scheduled_at ISO datetime string as a human-readable label: 'Mon 5 May 09:00'. Returns empty string for null/undefined.

private_objects.name: viewFetchUrl
private_objects.purpose: [CHANGED] Return the correct /api/tasks query URL for a given view tab (active, scheduled, pending_board, done).

private_objects.name: PRIORITY_COLOUR
private_objects.purpose: Map of priority string to CSS color value for priority chip rendering.

private_objects.name: PRIORITY_SYMBOL
private_objects.purpose: Map of priority string to directional arrow symbol (↑, –, ↓).

private_objects.name: LINK_TYPE_OPTIONS
private_objects.purpose: Static options array for the link type selector in LinkModal.
